finding.initial_defect: The old stop_signals lifetime ended before exceptional pool.shutdown. SIGINT during that wait could abort draining and unwind campaign_lock while live workers remained.
finding.resolution: Deferred handlers now cover shutdown. The directory-lock release lease is disabled before constructing a pool and re-enabled only after confirmed draining. An interrupted/unconfirmed shutdown preserves the lock and produces no complete/resumable receipt. Persistent journal failures are handled after draining.

read_only_checks: Workers call the unchanged one_seed entry point and own distinct seed directories; the coordinator alone writes the global completion file.
Complete fixed eight-seed cohort, only the next registered 100000/300000 prefix, and precision-only all-cohort decision are required before workers launch.
Previous sample/diagnostic prefixes, restart-state files, settings, model, source and imported-module paths are guarded.
Failures stop admissions, drain submitted work, and bind the exact resulting checkpoint/RNG states for explicit failure-receipt resumption.
The completion file is newly linked atomically only after all eight seeds are complete and final guards pass; existing output is not overwritten.
Mutable worker count only controls admissions, with a ceiling of four and no alteration of scientific settings or seed order.
operational_limits: The older direct quantum_sampling_campaign CLI does not acquire the new directory lock. It must remain stopped, and no old dispatcher or direct one_seed invocation may be launched concurrently.
A hard crash or unconfirmed drain intentionally leaves a lock requiring process/checkpoint inspection; do not auto-remove it.
The bounded tests validate coordinator failure handling with fake workers. They are not a new sampling or physical-convergence validation.
